pullRequest.title: Show shifts and swap deadlines in site time
pullRequest.body: Everyone reads the board in Hamburg time, so showing UTC keeps causing missed swaps. Shift times are now shown in the site's local time, and each shift shows its swap deadline: swaps must be agreed 48 hours before the shift starts.
pullRequest.author: sam
